correctness.rationale: Marked interarrival times are iid Erlang(n,gamma), so the stationary renewal covariance transform gives F=[(1+z²)^n−1]/|(1+iz)^n−1|² for z=omega/gamma. The sign of F−1 is sign[Re(1+iz)^n−1]. Substituting theta=arctan z gives H_n(theta)=cos(n theta)/cos(theta)^n, H_n prime=−n sin((n−1)theta)/cos(theta)^(n+1); its strict alternating extrema below −1/above 1 and final divergent endpoint imply exactly floor(n/2)−1 simple positive roots. At omega=0 the continuous value 1/n; n=1 is a flat Poisson exception, not counted. Independent symbolic positive Sturm root counts and squarefreeness passed n=2..48.

final_claim: For the stationary point-event train of marked returns in a homogeneous n-stage directed rate-gamma continuous-time cycle (n>=2), the normalized centered two-sided spectrum has exactly floor(n/2)-1 simple positive-frequency Poisson-plateau crossings, one in each stated disjoint theta phase interval, with alternating excess/deficit bands.
limitations: n>=2 homogeneous rate gamma>0, marked return event PSD with explicit two-sided convention.
n=1 is the Poisson flat spectrum; unequal-rate rings and unmarked jump streams are excluded.
